facts.fact: 他看见她眼泪的那一刻，夜帝与「凯萨斯命运管理者」两层身份当场脱落，只剩一个把妻子弄哭的男人。
facts.anchor: no longer the Night Emperor, no longer the steward of Kesath’s destiny, but just a man—a man who’d made his wife cry.

facts.fact: 他把那个喊着「管他呢、现在就去她身边」的自己按下去，先留下来善后。
facts.anchor: banishing that part of him that insisted to hell with it

facts.fact: 他承认今天这场集体处决更多是冲着她，而不是冲着凯萨斯。
facts.anchor: But the mass execution he’d meted out today—that had been more for her than for Kesath.

facts.fact: 他在影门里当面拒绝按现状签署《强化安全法令》，还说要大改甚至废掉。
facts.anchor: I will not sign it in its current state,

facts.fact: 盖赫里斯暗示可以立刻把她召来「纠正」，阿拉里克当场亮出镰刀。
facts.anchor: I should have sent for her sooner. Perhaps that may be rectified yet.

facts.fact: 她本能抬手要织盾，才想起自己已经没有以太术。
facts.anchor: remembered that she didn’t have her magic anymore

facts.fact: 凯德把她带到南翼侧门，说那里没有着陆网，只能从塔窗跳出去。
facts.anchor: we’ll have to jump out the tower window

facts.fact: 她推开那扇门，看见萨里曼，世界碎成一百万片。
facts.anchor: her world shattered into a million pieces as she beheld the sariman.
